# libero

> A Dioxus component library: typed style props (`Sx`), a theme of design
> tokens, and accessible components. Written in Rust, rendered to the web.

The docs site is a Dioxus app, so its HTML carries no content until the wasm
runs. Every docs page therefore also exists as plain markdown under `/md/`.

- [Markdown index](/md/index.md): every docs page as a standalone markdown
  file, grouped by component group. Start here - each entry links the page's
  own file, which carries the import line, examples, props, theme defaults,
  CSS variables and data attributes.

## Source

- [libero on GitHub](https://github.com/tdymel/libero): component source lives
  at `libero/src/components/<group>/<component>/`.
